title: Drum
description: An album title in ultra-condensed black capitals that fills the box top to bottom, printed on a row of drums. Swipe up or down and every letter rolls over on its own wheel to the next title, one wheel a beat after the last, curving away and darkening over the top of its cylinder before it clicks hard into the next notch.
intent: After Berton Hasebe's Druk for Commercial Type (https://type.today/en/journal/new-typeface-druk): extreme condensed proportions that fill a cover, set on a mechanical number drum with the weight of a Teenage Engineering readout.
